name: ernestdefoe/nameplate
description: The member's panel beside every post, the way traditional forums show it: rank, post count, join date, best answers and likes received — plus signature options that work with FoF Signature.

suggest.flarum/likes: Shows how many likes a member's posts have received.
suggest.fof/best-answer: Shows how many of a member's posts were chosen as the best answer.
suggest.fof/signature: Nameplate adds 'hide signatures' for members and 'once per page' for admins.
